summary: Complete web UI for `/configuracio`: own colla editor (logo, photo, `#RRGGBB` clothing colors, `GeoPoint`, website, social links), guest colles CRUD (`board`/`admin`), and **Achievements (Fites / Logros)** CRUD accessible to **`technical`, `board`, and `admin`**. **Web only** (consumes backend from `spec-groups-achievements`).
overview:
Fase 3 web UI slice implementing the `/configuracio` section on top of the complete `groups` and `achievements` backend built in `spec-groups-achievements`.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §4.4, §5.9, §6.1.1, §7.4 (Configuració) · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `spec-groups-achievements` (all `/api/v1/groups*`, `/api/v1/achievements*`, and `:core` `MuixerangaApi` extensions).
- `platform-web-shell` (`/configuracio` route gated by `config:write || achievements:write`).
- `spec-03-calendar` (optional event picker when linking an achievement to an event).

**Role-aware UI rules (`decisiones.md`)**
- **`board` / `admin`** (`config:write` + `groups:write` + `achievements:write`): sees all 3 subsections inside `/configuracio` — **La nostra colla** (edit own group), **Altres colles** (guest colles CRUD), and **Fites / Logros** (achievements CRUD).
- **`technical`** (`achievements:write`, without `groups:write`/`config:write`): enters `/configuracio` from the navigation bar, sees **Fites / Logros** with full create/edit/delete/logo actions, and either sees colla info in read-only mode or defaults directly to the Fites tab (no group write controls rendered).
- **`member`**: `/configuracio` is hidden from navigation and blocked by route guard.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :app:shared:jvmTest :app:webApp:compileKotlinWasmJs` passes.
- `board`/`admin` can edit own colla (`name`, `subtitle`, `foundation`, `history`, `contact`, `location`, `#RRGGBB` swatches for `faixa`/`shirt`/`trousers`, `website`, `socialLinks`, logo & image upload/delete) and manage guest colles (cannot delete own colla).
- `technical`, `board`, and `admin` can create, edit, delete, and upload logos for achievements (with optional `groupId` and `eventId` links).
- Client-side validation rejects invalid `#RRGGBB` hex colors before submitting and handles `409 version_conflict` with reload prompt.
shared_ui_policy: All screens, ViewModels, and repositories live in `:app:shared` `commonMain`. `:app:webApp` hosts wasm only. Zero `:server` changes in this slice (`decisiones.md`). Android/desktop/JS out of v1 scope.
out_of_scope:
- `:server` endpoints (completed in `spec-groups-achievements`).
- Global app theme editing (colla colors in `TabalaTheme` are static brand tokens).
- Astro CMS controls.
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.client: Bearer JWT via `SessionManager`. Route `/configuracio` accessible when `config:write` OR `achievements:write` is present; group edit actions gated on `groups:write`, achievement edit actions gated on `achievements:write`.

components.name: ConfigRepository
components.usage: Wraps `MuixerangaApi` groups & achievements methods (including logo/image multipart upload & delete) and optional events lookup for achievement linking.

components.name: ConfigViewModel
components.usage: Exposes `StateFlow<ConfigUiState>` managing active tab (`La nostra colla`, `Altres colles`, `Fites`), role capability flags (`canEditGroups`, `canEditAchievements`), client-side `#RRGGBB` / URL validation, media uploads, and `409` conflict reload.
components.notes: Defaults initial tab to `Fites` when `!canEditGroups && canEditAchievements` (`technical`).

components.name: ConfiguracioScreen + GroupFormDialog + AchievementFormDialog
components.usage: Route `/configuracio`: `KpiFilterStrip` (colles, fites), tabbed layout (`La nostra colla`, `Altres colles`, `Fites`), hex color swatch list editor (`faixa`, `shirt`, `trousers`), logo/image upload & remove controls, `GeoPoint` coordinates input, `socialLinks` form, guest colles list (own group delete disabled), and achievements list + create/edit/delete dialog with optional `groupId` & `eventId` selectors.

structure:
Web-only feature slice:

```text
Web /configuracio (ConfiguracioScreen)
  ├─ Tab 1: La nostra colla  (editable by board/admin; read-only or hidden for technical)
  ├─ Tab 2: Altres colles    (CRUD by board/admin)
  └─ Tab 3: Fites / Logros   (CRUD by technical, board, admin)
        ↓
ConfigViewModel → ConfigRepository → :core MuixerangaApi (spec-groups-achievements)
```

sections.title: Hex color swatch editor (`faixa`, `shirt`, `trousers`)
sections.description: Reusable Compose component showing visual color chips for each `#RRGGBB` entry with add/remove controls and instant validation against `:core` hex validator.
sections.behavior: Validates `#RRGGBB` format on input and normalizes uppercase hex before sending `PatchField` updates.

sections.title: Role-based tabs (`technical` vs `board`/`admin`)
sections.description: `ConfigViewModel` derives `canEditGroups = Permission.GROUPS_WRITE in permissions` and `canEditAchievements = Permission.ACHIEVEMENTS_WRITE in permissions`.
sections.behavior: For `technical` (`canEditAchievements && !canEditGroups`), opens directly on `Fites` and hides all group create/edit/delete/upload actions. For `board`/`admin`, opens on `La nostra colla` with full access to all 3 tabs.

persistence: No client persistence; all mutations hit `:server` APIs from `spec-groups-achievements`.

tasks.title: ConfigRepository + ConfigViewModel

`jvmTest` verifies `board` can save own group and create/delete guest groups
